title: Retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount 10-Inch solid brass pullout rod, Fresno Collection Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade tight spaces with a retractable hooks and garment rod that pulls out for hanging garments or towels and retracts neatly when not in use—ideal for the Fresno collection and other modern bath accessories.

  • Space-saving pullout design: Extends to create a handy hanging point, then retracts into the housing.
  • Clean wall-mounted install: Installs in an end wall or door frame with concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted from the finest solid brass materials.
  • Coordinated look: Designed for matching Fresno and minimalist bathroom hardware layouts.
  • Designer finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors.

Specifications

  • Projection/extension: 10-Inch
  • Overall size: 10-Inch L x 2-Inch W x 1.9-Inch H
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Required wall depth to retract: 10 inches
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Included items: brass rod, rod housing, and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Fresno Collection Retractable Pullout Garment Rod
_previous.description: Enjoy the convenience of this pull out garment rod in many places around your home. Rod installs in an end wall or door frame and retracts when not in use. When the rod is extended it provides a handy place to hang your garments or towels. Great in a laundry area, dressing area or in the bathroom. Garment rod requires 10 inches of wall depth to retract. Crafted of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
